dependencies.parallel_lane_rule: GPR PCV-03F remains independent. MTLC can consume sealed/current source contracts; it cannot activate or mutate another lane.

scope.name: Readiness, Homework, and Prep Cockpits
scope.responsibility: Centralize everything players and GMs must finish before the next session through Next Actions, GM Attention, homework, approvals, readiness checks, pack/content readiness, session preflight, and Minimum Viable Prep that minimizes clerical workload.
exit_criteria: Each participant can answer what still needs attention from one surface.
The GM can see player blockers and likely-relevant prep without searching multiple systems.
Sparse useful NPC/scene/clue/thread records are supported; encyclopedic completion is not required.
A session Ready state reflects actual character/content/sync/prep readiness.
The workflow does not impose more mandatory clerical prep than it removes.

next_action: Await a new owner execution instruction to begin MTLC-06 Readiness, Homework, and Prep Cockpits. Do not grant branch or implementation authority merely from selection.

stop_reason.evidence: MTLC-05 completion selects strict successor MTLC-06 but does not start it.
